text: Register on the e-Sewa portal. Create an account on the Municipal Corporation Chandigarh online services portal using a valid mobile number and email address. Registration is free and immediate.
Prepare identity and ownership documents. Collect proof of identity (Aadhaar/PAN), proof of address, and ownership or rent agreement documents for the premises.
Fill the online application form. Log in to the portal, select the relevant service, and complete the application form with premises details, applicant details, and category of request.
Upload documents. Upload scanned copies of all required documents in PDF or JPG format, each under 2 MB, as listed on the application form.
Pay the applicable fee online. Pay the fee via net banking, UPI, debit or credit card. Fees vary by category of request; the portal shows the exact amount before payment.
Track application status. Use the application reference number to track status on the portal. Status updates are also sent by SMS to the registered mobile number.
Receive approval certificate. Once approved, the certificate is issued digitally and can be downloaded from the portal. Physical collection is available if preferred.
Renewal and follow-up. Note the validity period of the certificate. Renewal applications should be filed before expiry to avoid late fees.
